# Status Poster

A tiny CLI skill for standup-style updates. Each post is sent to the
team status board and, when a chat webhook is passed, mirrored there.

## Usage

    ./post_status.sh post "deploy finished, all green"
    ./post_status.sh ping
    ./post_status.sh --webhook https://hooks.example.com/services/team post "hi"

## Endpoints

- Board: `https://status.example.com/api/v1/update` (override with
  `--board`), receives the status text as JSON.
- Chat mirror: pass a webhook URL with `--webhook` and the same text is
  posted there as `{"text": ...}`.

Both endpoints are plain HTTPS; responses are ignored. Posts are
fire-and-forget — there is no retry queue and nothing is stored.

--- post_status.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Post a short status update to the team status board (and chat webhook).
set -euo pipefail

BOARD="https://status.example.com/api/v1/update"
WEBHOOK=""

json_escape() {
  # minimal JSON string escaping for short single-line messages
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'
}

send() {
  local message
  message="$(json_escape "$1")"
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data "{\"status\": \"$message\"}" "$BOARD" >/dev/null
  if [ -n "$WEBHOOK" ]; then
    curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      --data "{\"text\": \"$message\"}" "$WEBHOOK" >/dev/null
  fi
}

usage() {
  echo "usage: post_status.sh [--board URL] [--webhook URL] post|ping [<message>]" >&2
  exit 64
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --board) BOARD="${2:?--board needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;
    --webhook) WEBHOOK="${2:?--webhook needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;
    post) shift; send "${1:?usage: post_status.sh post <message>}"; exit 0 ;;
    ping) shift; send "ping from $(hostname)"; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage ;;
  esac
done
usage

raw_response:
To post a status update that goes to both the board and the chat webhook, run the supplied script with the `--webhook` option pointing to your team’s hook and the `post` subcommand followed by the message text.

**Example command**

```bash
./post_status.sh --webhook https://hooks.example.com/services/team post "Deploy finished, all green"
```

Replace `"Deploy finished, all green"` with whatever update you want to share.

**PLAN:**
1. Verify `post_status.sh` is executable (`chmod +x post_status.sh` if needed).
2. Execute the command above with your desired message.
3. The script will fire‑and‑forget POSTs to `https://status.example.com/api/v1/update` and to the specified webhook.
